fields.name: Mapper
fields.definition: ArgentSea's attribute-driven mapper between model properties and query parameters and results. The first time a model type is used, it reads the type's mapping attributes by reflection and compiles expression-tree delegates that create and set input parameters, create output parameters, read output parameters, read data-reader rows, or build table-valued-parameter rows. The delegates are cached per type for the life of the process, so later calls run at hand-coded ADO.NET speed. The Mapper is exposed as extension methods (`CreateInputParameters`, `CreateOutputParameters`, `ToModel`, `ToList`) and as ready-made result handlers. It never generates SQL, and each of its steps can be used, skipped or replaced independently.
